The committee took public testimony on the measure.
The committee weighed the testimony it heard and voted on reporting the bill.
Scheduled for Third consideration and passage on the floor.
Third consideration and passage required 50 of 98 (a majority of the members elected to the house).
Sent to the Senate for its own consideration.

Delivered to the Governor.
The executive signed the bill.
The measure completed every required step and became law.
